description: Windows candidates that were built and frozen but rejected before publication. Their engineering release ids are spent exactly like published ones: scripts/windows/release-identity.mjs refuses to build or audit any of them again, so a rejected artifact's identity can never become the identity of a different one. The binaries are not tracked; each entry records what identifies the rejected bytes. The display version of a rejected candidate is NOT spent, because it was never published. Add an entry when a candidate is rejected; never edit or remove one.

releases.reason: After an upgrade from RC3 the browser kept running RC3's service-worker-cached interface; applying an update in one tab reloaded the others; /__civic/platform was answered by the service worker; a classic scrollbar shifted the application bar. Corrected in Phase 5.1 (docs/phase-5.1-runtime-update-safety.md).
